correctness.rationale: The projection formula follows directly from angular orthogonality and radial moments; the finite Hankel block is exactly upper reverse-triangular and has nonzero antidiagonal; direct monomial singular values and norm follow by anti-diagonal weighted permutation; the compactly supported weak limit follows from uniform convergence on interior t ranges and dominated endpoint Riemann sums, identifying the density and beta moments. The standalone finite checker passed 7,334 diagnostics and is not treated as proof of the infinite statements.

value.rationale: A natural operator-quantization question for polynomial Toeplitz operators receives a complete sharp singular-spectrum answer in every monomial degree, a universal nontrivial weak limiting measure with explicit density and all Schatten moments, and sharp operator/trace/Hilbert–Schmidt scalings. It clarifies how a sequence of individual finite-rank nilpotent defects accumulates macroscopic singular mass, rather than merely redoing a rank calculation.
